## Description {#details}

<p>C++ source file with implementations for the µTest++ utility functions.</p>


<p>This source file contains the implementations of the utility functions for the µTest++ framework. It provides <span class="doxyComputerOutput">extract_file_name()</span>, which strips the folder path from a file path returning only the base name, and <span class="doxyComputerOutput">is_match()</span>, which performs wildcard pattern matching with <span class="doxyComputerOutput">*</span> (any sequence of characters) and <span class="doxyComputerOutput">?</span> (any single character) support, and the <span class="doxyComputerOutput">split()</span> overload for string views.</p>


<p>All definitions reside within the <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/utility">micro_os_plus::micro_test_plus::utility</a></span> namespace.</p>


<p>This file must be included when building the µTest++ library.</p>
